lines.zh: 沙子在脚下滑，我走得不快。
lines.en: The sand slips under me; I do not walk fast.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我沿着湿线走。
lines.en: The tide pulled back; I walk along the wet line.

lines.zh: 身后拖出一道浅浅的沟。
lines.en: A shallow groove trails behind me.

lines.zh: 每一步都像有人拽着脚踝。
lines.en: Each step feels like a hand on my ankle.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，礁石也比我快。
lines.en: I move slowly; even the reef outruns me.
Shells crunch somewhere beneath my hide.
Only at low tide do I dare shift a few steps.
I am in no hurry, and the sea does not hurry me.

lines.zh: 走一步，蜡面就裂开一点。
lines.en: Each step cracks the wax a little more.

lines.zh: 我沿着岸线走，不碰深海。
lines.en: I keep to the shoreline, away from deep water.
The waves erase my prints almost at once.
After long walking, sand packs into my seams.
I am stuck in the sand, waiting for the tide.

lines.zh: 潮声一下一下，像我呼吸。
lines.en: The surf beats like my own breathing.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候像块旧木头。
lines.en: When still, I look like a piece of old driftwood.

lines.zh: 海鸟落在我背上，又飞走。
lines.en: A gull lands on my back and leaves again.

lines.zh: 涨潮会把我抬起来一点。
lines.en: The rising water lifts me a little.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，数到七就乱了。
lines.en: I count waves and lose track at seven.
The wind blows salt into my cracks.

lines.zh: 我等着，等一个不会来的浪。
lines.en: I wait for a wave that will not come.
My waxed hide shines like wet stone.
The shore is loud; I am quiet.

lines.zh: 你站在干沙上，离潮线太远。
lines.en: You stand on dry sand, too far from the tide line.
I look up and see your boots first.
You carry the smell of sea salt.

lines.zh: 你的影子落在我壳上，很凉。
lines.en: Your shadow falls cool across my shell.
I am watching to see if you will kick me.
You stoop, and I flinch.
Your hand is much too close.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，像盯着一块浮木。
lines.en: I stare at you as at a drifting log.
The sand under you is sinking.

lines.zh: 你的火把在潮气里发抖。
lines.en: Your torch flickers in the damp.
My shell cracks like breaking wood.
That blow went through the wax.
I stagger a step and hold.
Sand gets into the wound.
I let out one low cry.

lines.zh: 疼从脊背一直传到尾尖。
lines.en: The pain runs from spine to tail tip.
Will you try that again?
My wax took that blow for nothing.
Suddenly the surf sounds very loud.
I hold myself up; I do not fall.
That thing in your hand is not a fish.
I will not eat it, but I want to sniff it.

lines.zh: 你把东西放低些，我就靠近。
lines.en: Lower it, and I may come closer.

lines.zh: 我闻到油，不是海水的咸。
lines.en: I smell oil, not the salt of the sea.

lines.zh: 那颜色太亮，晃得我眨眼。
lines.en: The colour is so bright I blink.
I open my mouth, then close it without biting.

lines.zh: 你把桶放下，我就信你一点。
lines.en: Set the bucket down and I trust you a little.
I stretch my neck only as far as your shadow.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起退潮的滩。
lines.en: This smell reminds me of a low-tide flat.
I shift half a step and stop.
You bumped into me; I remember it.
Do not push; my shell will ring.

lines.zh: 我再被撞一下就要还手了。
lines.en: One more knock and I will hit back.

lines.zh: 你的靴底压住了我的尾。
lines.en: Your boot is pinning down my tail.
That was not heavy, but it counts.

lines.zh: 我身上的蜡被蹭掉一块。
lines.en: A patch of wax scraped off me.
Get to the dry sand and I will not chase.
I turn slowly; do not rush me.

lines.zh: 撞我的人通常只撞一次。
lines.en: Those who bump me usually do it only once.

lines.zh: 蜡层护着我，你也感觉到了。
lines.en: The wax guards me; you felt it too.

lines.zh: 这片滩上，没有第二个我。
lines.en: There is no second one of me on this shore.

lines.zh: 我喊过几次，只有浪回答。
lines.en: I called a few times; only the surf answered.

lines.zh: 潮水带来别的东西，从不是我。
lines.en: The tide brings other things, never my kind.

lines.zh: 我把头埋进沙里，不再找。
lines.en: I bury my head in sand and stop looking.

lines.zh: 就算有同类，也隔着整片海。
lines.en: Even if one exists, an ocean lies between us.

lines.zh: 我身上的蜡，没有别人涂过。
lines.en: No one else has ever waxed me.
Loneliness is a very slow ache.

lines.zh: 我对着空滩叫，声音散得快。
lines.en: I call to the empty flat; the sound scatters.

lines.zh: 我等的不是伴，是一声回应。
lines.en: I wait not for a mate, but for an answer.
The tide goes out; I am still alone.

lines.zh: 有东西滚到我脚边，我没捡。
lines.en: Something rolled to my feet; I did not take it.

lines.zh: 我把贝壳推到一边，让开路。
lines.en: I nudge a shell aside to clear the way.

lines.zh: 这枚钉子在我壳下硌着。
lines.en: This nail is pressing under my shell.

lines.zh: 我衔起海藻，又吐了出来。
lines.en: I pick up kelp and spit it out.

lines.zh: 你掉的东西，我用鼻子顶回去。
lines.en: I nose your dropped item back to you.
There is always something hard under the sand.
I do not collect things; I only block the way.

lines.zh: 一块碎玻璃卡在我缝里。
lines.en: A shard of glass is stuck in my seam.

lines.zh: 我把石头挪开，底下有蟹。
lines.en: I move the stone; a crab is under it.
Do not leave your rubbish on my back.
That shadow over there is not a gull.

lines.zh: 有个东西在礁石后面磨牙。
lines.en: Something grinds its teeth behind the reef.

lines.zh: 它顺着潮线朝我挪过来。
lines.en: It works toward me along the tide line.
I lower my head, slowly.
The smell is wrong: rotten.

lines.zh: 我不先动手，但我准备好了。
lines.en: I will not strike first, but I am ready.
It crushed a crab shell underfoot.
The wax on my back tightens.
That thing is counting my steps.
The beach is too open; there is nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我听见骨头碰骨头的声音。
lines.en: I hear bone knocking against bone.
It circles around to my leeward side.
I know that kind of footstep.

lines.zh: 它要是撞上来，就怪不得我。
lines.en: If it bumps into me, that is on it.

lines.zh: 它从水里爬上来，身上滴水。
lines.en: It climbs out of the water, dripping.

lines.zh: 那股味道绕着礁石转了一圈。
lines.en: That smell circles the reef once.

lines.zh: 我盯着它的膝盖，不是眼睛。
lines.en: I watch its knees, not its eyes.
When it moves, I turn with it.

lines.zh: 我数着它的步子，等它靠近。
lines.en: I count its steps and wait for it to close in.
The water runs back and forth between us.
I press my weight down into the sand.
It raises its arm.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴已经横过来了。
lines.en: My tail is already swung across.

lines.zh: 它不明白我为什么不动。
lines.en: It does not understand why I do not move.
I wait for it to touch me first.

lines.zh: 沙子在我脚下响了一声。
lines.en: The sand creaks once under me.

lines.zh: 它退半步，我就压上一步。
lines.en: It gives ground; I press one step forward.
I plant myself between it and the shallows.

lines.zh: 它身上的味道越来越近。
lines.en: Its stench draws nearer.
I have the distance measured now.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石挪，让它先过来。
lines.en: I slide along the reef and let it come.

lines.zh: 它抬头，我就把脖子压低。
lines.en: It lifts its head; I lower mine.
I count to three, then charge.
It goes left; my tail blocks first.

lines.zh: 浪退下去，距离短了一截。
lines.en: The wave pulls back and the gap shrinks.
Its breathing is heavy; I can hear it.
I ram my skull into its chest.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过去，沙全扬起来。
lines.en: My tail sweeps; the sand flies up.
It struck me; I strike back.
The rim of my shell rakes its leg.
I shove it back two steps.

lines.zh: 这一下用了整条脊背的力。
lines.en: That blow used the strength of my whole spine.

lines.zh: 它抓住我的蜡壳，滑开了。
lines.en: It grabs my waxed shell and slips off.
I bite its wrist and hold.
A dull thud sounds in the sand.

lines.zh: 它倒下去，压塌一小片滩。
lines.en: It falls and crushes a patch of shore.
I twist my head and fling it at the reef.
The wax cracks, but I do not yield.

lines.zh: 它想绕后，被我一肘顶开。
lines.en: It tries to flank me; my elbow shoves it away.
I told you not to bump me.
I flip it onto the wet sand.
One headbutt and it stumbles back two steps.

lines.zh: 这一下撞在它的膝盖上。
lines.en: That one lands on its knee.
I press down with my whole body.

lines.zh: 它咬住我的蜡壳，牙陷进去了。
lines.en: It bites my wax shell and its teeth sink in.

lines.zh: 我甩它到礁石上，声音很闷。
lines.en: I throw it into the reef; the sound is dull.
The tide pushed me onto this flat.
I lift my head out of the foam.
The sand is still wet; I have just arrived.

lines.zh: 搁浅的地方，就是我的位置。
lines.en: Where I am stranded is where I stand.
Kelp still hangs from my hide.

lines.zh: 浪退下去，把我留在这里。
lines.en: The wave withdrew and left me here.
I hear the far sea drawing back.

lines.zh: 第一口空气有盐和铁味。
lines.en: My first breath tastes of salt and iron.
I plant myself on this shore.
Another one washed ashore.
I shake the water from my shell.
Before dawn, I must find a rock.
The wax melts; fire crawls over my shell.
I hit the sand with a thud like a burial.
Water fills my cracks; I cannot cough it out.

lines.zh: 气浪掀翻了我，壳嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast flips me; my shell rings.
An arrow sticks in the wax, still quivering.
Something seeps into my shell, cold.
I have not eaten a crab in days.
Lightning strikes; all my wax is scorched.
Below there is no sand and no sea.
